signals_info.description: Whether the associated conflict area is occupied; 0 means unoccupied.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 2 and 5 seconds from now, the intersection conflict area shall be unoccupied.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 2 秒到第 5 秒之间，路口冲突区域应至少有一个时刻处于未被占用状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the window from the second through the fifth second, the intersection conflict area shall be clear at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 2 秒至第 5 秒的窗口内，路口冲突区域应至少有一个时刻处于无占用状态。
